limitation: 503 alone cannot prove a non-idempotent update was not partially applied. The new general update retry is disabled, so the original graceful-shutdown indexing case remains unresolved. Pre-existing RouteException and communication-error replay safety is outside this fix and unproven.
summary: Avoid newly introduced non-RouteException 503 update replay and honor structured V2 skipRetry; retain the pre-existing RouteException and communication-error paths. Added focused mocked tests and clarified changelog.
verification: Source and diff review; git diff --check clean. No build, Gradle, tests, or executor run on Windows. Linux proof is requested separately at pr-5315-review-fixes-linux-gate-r2-20261110.
